resources.string: No EPUB or PDF files found in your Zotero library
You can find your Zotero API key at:\nhttps://www.zotero.org/settings/keys
Zotshelf does not collect any info from the user. See more here https://oyvindsolheim.com/other/zotshelf/terms_service
To use this app, you need to enter your Zotero credentials in the Settings.

• View all your EPUB and PDF books at a glance
• Tap any cover to open the book in your Zotero Web Library
• Pull down to refresh your collection
• Supports both EPUB and PDF file formats
This app was developed by Øyvind Solheim (@Oyvindbs@nerdculture.de) with a lot of help from the Claude AI. See the code or propose changes on https://www.github.com/oyvindbso/zotshelf
Enjoy ZotShelf? Buy me a coffee: https://buymeacoffee.com/oyvindbs or propose new features/code on gihub (above).
ZotShelf displays your EPUB and PDF book covers from your Zotero library in a convenient shelf.
ZotShelf only downloads books from the collections you open, so a large library won\'t fill up your phone. You can add more tabs later with the + button.
No internet connection. Cannot fetch collections.

Cover images are kept on this device so your shelves load quickly. Books are only downloaded briefly to get their covers and are deleted right after. Deleting the cache frees up space; covers are fetched again the next time you open a tab. Your Zotero library is not affected.
This deletes %1$s of cached cover images from this device. Nothing is deleted from Zotero.
